questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low ground railroad crossing. The railroad tracks cross the road at a steep angle. Low vehicles may scrape or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road may be slippery when wet. Drive carefully on slippery roads.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Until after you pass the sign.
Unless it seems safe to do so.

questions.explanation: White rectangular signs show rules you must follow. This sign means you cannot pass other vehicles under any circumstances.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign indicates a hospital with emergency services is located to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road is curving sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is curving sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show sharp curves in the direction of the arrow. In this case, the road curves sharply to the left. Multiple chevron signs may be placed throughout the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road you are on ends at an intersection ahead. Slow down and prepare to stop or turn before reaching the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching a school or school crosswalk.
Slow down, drive with caution, and watch for children.

questions.explanation: This sign appears on roads near schools. It warns drivers to slow down, be careful, and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to upcoming conditions. This sign warns that you are leaving a separated one-way highway and entering a two-way highway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in the lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs control traffic speed and movement. They display rules drivers must follow. This sign means you cannot park in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that you are leaving a divided highway and entering a road where traffic flows in both directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow and black. This sign tells you a lane is ending. Be ready to allow other traffic to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. This sign warns that a traffic light is coming. Be prepared to stop for a red or yellow light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a four-way intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You should stop for other traffic.
Traffic is entering from another road and you should allow additional space for drivers to merge safely into the flow of traffic.
Traffic is entering from another road and you should keep right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is entering from another road and you should allow additional space for drivers to merge safely into the flow of traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic is merging from another road. Check your side and rear mirrors, then move to another lane if possible to give merging drivers space.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop, whether there is a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs indicate you are approaching a school zone or school crossing. Stay alert and be prepared to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield to trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield to trains.
questions.explanation: A round sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. This sign is posted a few hundred feet before the tracks. Slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that two-way traffic is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign marks a bicycle crossing or path. Drive carefully in this area because bicycles regularly cross or ride near traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction. The right lane ends soon and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction. The right lane ends soon and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you that one lane ahead is ending. Traffic must merge to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver extends their left arm and hand downward, they are signaling they will stop. If you are following this driver, adjust your speed accordingly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and do not use your brakes.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. Do not make a U-turn where you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road will turn sharply right and then sharply left ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs show traffic laws that you must always follow. Right turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a one-way road, entrance, or exit. If you see this sign facing you, traffic is coming toward you. Do not enter.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare you for road hazards. This sign warns that a sharp turn is coming and you should reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An octagonal (eight-sided) sign always means "stop." You must come to a complete stop at this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign shows that the road will turn sharply right and then sharply left ahead.
